## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (99%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Conformal set holds Normal only, input is typical, and all five neighbors agree [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 99%, Benign 1% | Strongly favors Normal |
| Conformal set | {Normal}, α=0.1 | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.99 / 44th percentile | Typical input |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Models concur |
| Similar cases | 5 of 5 Normal | Unanimous neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 4, 5, 6) · ↓ invasive · Prominent glands; lower invasive likelihood in concept model [F3] · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 7, 8, 11) · ↓ invasive · Prominent benign stroma; lower invasive likelihood [F4] · Validated
- **Normal lobules** (regions 0, 2, 7) · ↓ invasive · Largest term, but failed AI spot check (0/20) [F2] · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 8) · ↓ invasive · Below typical overall; only region 8 peaks · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Deletion CI excludes 0 (+0.54 logit); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes 0 (+0.002); not shown to reflect the classifier. Normal lobules is Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Reliability only modestly flags errors (AUROC 0.69, CI 0.58–0.87); high reliability is no guarantee.
- Calibration is imprecise on a small test set (ECE 0.05, upper bound 0.18).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 8, 9**: least benign-leaning on the heatmap; region 8 also peaks for infiltrating stroma.
2. **Region 1**: peak for mitoses and lymphocytes; mitosis score is Unreliable, so confirm by eye.
3. **Regions 0, 2, 7**: confirm two-layered normal lobules; this concept failed its spot check.
